name: Trequila
description: Open-source BYOK trip planning API with real-time updates

NATS_URL.description: NATS JetStream URL (use Synadia NGS or similar)

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret key for JWT signing (must be at least 32 bytes)

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32-byte base64 encoded master key for AES-256-GCM encryption of user API keys. Generate via: openssl rand -base64 32

CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of frontend origins allowed by CORS. Defaults to https://trequila.namankhandelwal.dev

FRONTEND_URL.description: Base URL the OAuth callback redirects the browser back to. Defaults to https://trequila.namankhandelwal.dev
